findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: browse_or_join_roll_call_table_shares · Private data: submit_vip_table_or_guestlist_hold · Public sink: submit_vip_table_or_guestlist_hold · Destructive: shop_vegas_entertainers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: browse_or_join_roll_call_table_shares · Private data: submit_vip_table_or_guestlist_hold · Public sink: submit_vip_table_or_guestlist_hold · Destructive: shop_vegas_entertainers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
